hook: In nineteen thirty-two, Australia went to war against birds. And lost.
twist: A real army unit with machine guns was sent against emus and was withdrawn after about a month.
angle: How does a modern army lose to birds? Walk through each failed tactic until the major's own verdict.
why_now: Evergreen; peaks around its November anniversary.
risks: Heavily covered by other channels: our edge is the deadpan escalation and the 10-bullets-per-bird number.
